title: Find Longest Awesome Substring
description: You are given a string `s` consisting only of digits `'0'` through `'9'`. An awesome substring is a non-empty contiguous substring of `s` whose characters can be rearranged (via any number of swaps) to form a palindrome. Return the length of the longest awesome substring of `s`.
hints: A substring can be rearranged into a palindrome iff at most one digit appears an odd number of times.
Track a 10-bit prefix parity mask and store the earliest index seen for each of the 1024 masks; at each index check mask and mask ^ (1 << d) for d = 0..9.

examples.explanation: All digits are distinct, so the longest awesome substring has length 1.
